name: DJI O3 video (with Goggles 2)

source.reference: DJI states 10 km (FCC) at < 33 dBm EIRP for the O3 Air Unit with DJI Goggles 2. Free-space loss over 10 km at 5.7875 GHz is 127.7 dB; 33 - 127.7 + 3 dBi (dji-goggles-2-5g8 antenna) = -91.7 dBm. Source: DJI O3 Air Unit User Manual v1.0, specifications: 'Transmitter Power (EIRP) FCC: <33 dBm; SRRC: <30 dBm; CE: <14 dBm', 'Max. Transmission Distance FCC: <10 km'
DJI O3 Air Unit User Manual v1.0: 'Min. Latency (end-to-end) Used with DJI Goggles 2: 1080p/100fps: 30 ms'

notes: DJI does not publish receiver sensitivity. The threshold is derived so that this profile, with the dji-o3-air-unit-5g8 antenna (1.5 dBi) and the dji-goggles-2-5g8 antenna (3 dBi) from the library, reaches DJI's stated FCC range in free space: it is DJI's range claim, not a measured sensitivity. txPowerDbm is DJI's EIRP limit minus the air antenna gain: 14 dBm EIRP (CE) and 33 dBm EIRP (FCC). DJI drops bandwidth and bitrate as the signal weakens, so the threshold is for its narrowest mode near the range limit. Replace it with your own measurement when you have one. Unverified until an admin checks the source.
